source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: The Chairman of Adjudicators is responsible for determining how many couples are recalled; the organizer is only consulted (IV.C.1.d).

requirement: Before an NDCA scoring profile is enabled, the callback count must be set or explicitly authorized by the NDCA Chairman of Adjudicators through a verified event-level role, and the decision-maker, callback target, rule version, exceptions and audit history recorded per round.
enforcement_point: Not built. NDCA advancement support is NOT IMPLEMENTED and a BLOCKER to NDCA scoring-profile activation (OD-09). Docs-only record: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Today the event manager sets the callback target (start_competition_round, A4a guard) and no Chairman role exists. Role mapping is shared with OD-05/OD-06 (PR 834). Do not equate a DanceFlow owner/manager with the Chairman. The consult-the-organizer duty is IV.C.1.d (recommended, see OD09-NDCA-0005).
decision_refs: OD-09 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option C now / Option A required for a future NDCA scoring profile; retrospective audit PR #795)
